system.description:
Select one from: [Flame] [Cold] [Shock] [Blight] [Holy] [Spirit]. The target gains [Cancel (Chosen Tag): 40]. This Cancel effect is removed after applying its effects once.

(Fate 1): You can use this skill with [Timing: Instant].

A magic that envelops the target with a barrier that cancels out various attributes. The attacks that can be prevented are limited, but they demonstrate a high defensive effect against those that respond.
